label: 600233 圆通速递 Full Research v1

discovery.economic_direction: parcel-share growth plus unit-cost efficiency and capex normalization

factual_observations.statement: H1 earnings and cash flow inflected sharply while parcel volume outgrew the industry.
July volume growth remained double-digit while industry July volume growth was low single-digit.
Fresh post-H1 sell-side 2027 profit expectations cluster near CNY7.0-7.5bn.

discovery.why_now: H1 unit-profit recovery, continued share gains and a possible capex rollover justify first investment-grade Full Research; expectation envelope comes before probability.
discovery.current_market_expression: A-share 600233; production Odds must use HiThink ObservedMarket.
discovery.contradiction_or_mapping_warning: H1 profit growth is real, but YTO's own unit revenue still declined and aviation remains loss-making; do not mistake anti-involution relief for a permanently higher price regime.
discovery.next_discriminating_search: Bridge 2027 profit from parcel volume/share, unit revenue, unit cost, non-core drag and capex/owner-cash economics.
discovery.known_stop_or_downgrade_condition: Do not upgrade Belief if unit-profit recovery requires renewed price inflation that is not observable.

pre_research.what_is_this: Scaled franchise express-delivery network with owned hubs, transport/aviation resources and smaller international/freight businesses.
pre_research.economic_direction: parcel-share growth plus unit-cost efficiency and capex normalization
pre_research.why_surfaced_now: H1 profit/cash-flow acceleration coincided with continued share gains and materially lower per-ticket costs.
pre_research.current_expression_or_leadership: A-share 600233; #2-ish domestic express profitability/scale position behind ZTO on unit economics.
pre_research.basic_business_role: National parcel network monetizing volume through franchise pickup/delivery, owned transfer infrastructure, line-haul and service quality.
pre_research.potential_fundamental_driver: Share gains plus lower unit cost can lift express unit profit; slower capex can convert accounting earnings into stronger owner cash flow.
pre_research.current_market_expectation_hypothesis: Fresh sell-side 2027 attributable-profit center is around CNY7.2-7.3bn; the market is already underwriting much of the H1 profit persistence.

material_claims.statement: 2026H1 revenue was CNY38.893bn, group attributable profit CNY3.175bn, operating cash flow CNY3.959bn, and express volume 16.278bn parcels.
Fresh post-H1 sell-side 2027 attributable-profit forecasts cluster around CNY6.951-7.542bn.

pre_research.obvious_contradiction: YTO's H1 and July unit revenue were still slightly down YoY, so the profit inflection is not simply a price-hike story.
pre_research.largest_unknown: How much of H1 unit-profit improvement survives if industry pricing discipline weakens?
pre_research.next_discriminating_search: Separate durable network/productivity savings from anti-involution-dependent margin recovery and non-core drag.
pre_research.route_reason: Evidenced earnings inflection with an unresolved unit-economics durability question.

quick_research.business_model: Franchise parcel network with owned transfer/transport infrastructure; earnings are driven by parcels times unit economics, with smaller freight/aviation/international activities.
quick_research.segment_mix: Domestic time-definite express dominates revenue and profit; freight forwarding is smaller, while aviation/international businesses can dilute group economics.
quick_research.economic_role: Scaled national parcel-network operator competing on service, network efficiency, cost and franchise health.
major_profit_drivers: pickup-delivery, line-haul and hub unit cost
quick_research.value_chain_position: Integrated brand/network orchestrator with franchise endpoints and owned core transfer/transport assets.
quick_research.current_industry_state: Industry parcel volume is growing mid-single digits while regulators continue anti-involution governance; competition is shifting toward service and efficiency rather than pure low-price volume.
quick_research.market_expectation_hypothesis: Use the fresh CNY6.95-7.54bn 2027 sell-side envelope as the center of observable expectation space, not as truth.
quick_research.current_expression_or_leadership: A-share 600233; production Odds require HiThink market observation.

supporting_claims.statement: H1 unit revenue was CNY2.17 (-1.04% YoY), unit cost CNY1.90 (-5.99%), and unit gross profit CNY0.27 (+57.11%).
July YTO parcel volume grew 12.07% YoY versus 4.1% for industry July parcel volume.
Management said H1 capex was nearly CNY3.5bn and expects future capex to gradually slow.
Fresh post-H1 2027 forecasts span roughly CNY6.951-7.542bn and center near CNY7.3bn.

contradictory_claims.statement: YTO's H1 unit revenue fell 1.04% YoY and July unit revenue fell 0.86% YoY despite the industry's anti-involution repair.
H1 aviation revenue fell 45.24% YoY and aviation gross margin was -47.86%.

quick_research.evidence_authority_assessment: Company filings own reported operating/financial facts; National Post Bureau owns industry aggregates; IR owns management statements; sell-side owns expectation context only.
quick_research.variant_perception: The durable part of the earnings inflection may be share + network productivity + lower future capex, not headline price repair; however the market may be right to discount part of H1 because unit revenue still fell and anti-involution discipline is not guaranteed permanent.
unresolved_questions: durability of CNY0.20+ group unit profit
how much further core unit cost can fall
next_discriminating_evidence: monthly parcel volume and unit revenue
quick_research.route_reason: Probability requires an explicit volume × unit-economics bridge and a competitive-relapse downside.

material_claims.statement: H1 operating cash flow was CNY3.959bn; management reported nearly CNY3.5bn of H1 capex and expects the investment pace to gradually slow.

The H1 earnings inflection is more consistent with share gains plus lower unit cost than with company-specific price inflation; durability therefore depends on competitive discipline and continued network productivity.
Five 2027 worlds retain a below-consensus competitive relapse, two market-centered states and bounded efficiency/share upside without assuming unannounced dividends.

explicit_falsifiers: Unit-cost savings stall or reverse while unit revenue declines enough to materially compress express unit profit.
Parcel-share gains stall or reverse for multiple observations without a deliberate profitable-mix explanation.
2027 company-specific earnings evidence falls materially below CNY6.0bn.
Capex fails to slow while operating cash conversion weakens materially.
Aviation/international losses expand enough to offset core express improvement.

adversarial_findings.question: Expectation envelope first?
adversarial_findings.finding: Yes; fresh post-H1 2027 sell-side forecasts are reconstructed before scenario probability.

adversarial_findings.question: Is H1 profit merely anti-involution price inflation?
adversarial_findings.finding: No; YTO's own unit revenue still fell YoY while unit cost fell materially, but competitive discipline remains a real dependency.
adversarial_findings.resolution: Keep a 15% competitive-relapse world and explicit unit-revenue monitoring.

adversarial_findings.question: Is downside double-counting broad-market de-rating?
adversarial_findings.finding: No; the 8x downside is reserved for company/industry economic relapse, while broad-market regime remains outside Fundamental Belief.
adversarial_findings.resolution: Market regime stays in Participation/Odds only.

adversarial_findings.question: Are non-core losses hidden?
adversarial_findings.finding: No; aviation is explicitly loss-making and group profit trails express profit.
adversarial_findings.resolution: Keep non-core drag as an open question and falsifier.

research_snapshot.core_thesis: 圆通的2026H1盈利跃升主要来自份额增长与单票成本下降，而不是公司单票收入上行；若网络效率继续兑现、竞争纪律不重新恶化且资本开支逐步回落，2027 owner economics 可明显高于2025。核心风险是反内卷松动后单票利润回吐，以及航空/国际等非核心业务持续拖累。
research_snapshot.market_expectations_narrative: H1后新研报对2027归母净利润高度集中在约69.5-75.4亿元，中心约72-73亿元。该区间先定义可观察 expectation envelope，再由公司级因果链决定保留低于共识的竞争回撤世界和高于共识的效率/份额右尾。
research_snapshot.model_risk_notes: 成熟快递业务有月度件量/单票收入和季度成本可观测性，风险低于高波动科技可选性公司；但每票数分钱变化会显著放大到利润，竞争纪律与成本兑现仍使模型保持中等风险。
open_questions: H1单票利润改善中多少来自可持续效率、多少依赖行业竞争纪律？
2027份额能否继续提升而不牺牲单票利润？
航空/国际业务何时能减少对集团利润的拖累？
资本开支下降能否转化为稳定自由现金流和更高股东回报？
